notes.title: Dive Deep with Leila: Every Purchase Helps WDC Protect Marine Life
notes.content:
[h1]We are excited to announce our support for Whale and Dolphin Conservation (WDC) for World Oceans Day!
[/h1]

[h2]WDC's World Oceans Day Sale begins on June 5 and runs through June 12. During the event, you can take advantage of a great discount for Leila. Additionally, we will donate a portion of the proceeds from the event to support WDC's conservation efforts.

WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

By participating in this event, we will help WDC continue its global conservation work and ghost gear removal project, and contribute to funding 10 missions for divers to remove deadly entanglements for marine life (and scuba divers) from reefs, seabeds, and shipwrecks in UK waters.[/h2]

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.0.3)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thanks for playing our game and reporting bugs! Here is our second patch of the full release. Just some teeny-tiny fixes and improvements. Nothin' fancy here.

[h2]1.0.3[/h2] 

[h3]- [b]FIX:[/b] Mancave JigsawPiece dragging bug:[/h3]
[i]I Receive:[/i] No more cursor-loving-sticky-object bug;
[i]You Receive:[/i] No more rotating while dragging
[h3]- [b]UPD:[/b] Hold button behaviours improved:[/h3]
We noticed that hold interaction feedbacks on New Game button in Main Menu and Quit Game button in Pause Menu are unclear. To improve readability and interactability, we increased the reset times after button release and allowed buttons to be filled by either holding or pressing multiple times in succession.
These apply to all hold buttons in Main Menu and Pause Menu.
[h3]- [b]UPD:[/b] Mancave GridLight puzzle UX improved:[/h3]
We realized that getting the connection between puzzle components can be challenging, so we disable some elements once they are no longer needed to solve the next puzzles. To clarify: [spoiler]Darts and Cassettes interactions are disabled after Cassettes are placed in correct order.[/spoiler]

notes.title: That day has come—Leila is now available.
notes.content:
[h3]Two years of hard work, countless hours of thought, days filled with both joy and stress, conversations, events, tests, plenty of laughter and some tears… and finally, the day has arrived.
[/h3]

We hope you’ll appreciate Leila, her message, the insights she has developed about the world, the lessons she has learned, the solutions she has found, and ultimately, how far she has come on this journey. In these times when humanity—in every corner of the world—needs unity, kindness, equality, and freedom more than ever, we hope that Leila will be our small contribution to this effort.

Guided by our love for humanity’s oldest invention—game—and our belief in power of art to elevate words and spread them far and wide, we set out to create something that might outlast us. Now, we release Leila into the world, not just as a game to entertain, but as a story that celebrates self-forgiveness and solidarity as a path to healing. With tears of pride, we’ll watch her go. She no longer belongs to us alone—she’s now becoming part of a shared collective emotion.

Take good care of her.

notes.title: Leila on Steam on April 7th!
notes.content:
We are happy, we are proud, the big day has finally arrived! 

Leila has grown more than we imagined when we set out to tell the life journey of an ordinary woman. At the end of all our efforts, Leila is no longer just a part of us, but a common part of us that we share with you. 

It is our greatest wish that you love Leila, understand her, support her in this struggle to forgive herself and to re-exist, so that all of our efforts can make sense.

Endless thanks to everyone who has supported us on this journey, waited patiently for Leila and believed in the value of her story.

See you on April 7th right here <3

notes.title: Happy Lunar new year from Leila

Fellow mates,

From January 27th to February 10th, [i]Leila[/i] will be part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. All of us at Ubik Studios extend our heartfelt wishes to our incredible Asian player community.

As we welcome the new year, we’re continuing to actively work on [i]Leila[/i]. Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458430/_/

Enter the world of an everyday woman as you explore her past in this point & click narrative game. Hand-drawn animations bring her memories to life, and thought-provoking puzzles lay bare the reasons behind her choices. Immerse yourself in a story unfolds as you decipher its intricate pieces.

Wishing you all a Happy New Year in the Year of the Snake!

The [i]Leila[/i] Team

notes.title: Leila is at The Storyteller's Festival!
notes.content:
The Storyteller's Festival, a celebration of the art of storytelling, featuring a wide variety of visual novels and narrative games showcasing the best of interactive fiction, is just around the corner. As Ubik Studios, we will take part in The Storyteller's Festival organized by the indie studio Two and a Half Studios with our game Leila.

With over 150 games in the visual novel and narrative game genres and plenty of demos for players to try out, we are happy to be taking part in the festival.

At The Storyteller's Festival, we will be running two live-stream events. In these streams, two amazing streamers will play our demo live. 

We will introduce Leila, our game that we have created by believing in the power of storytelling, to game lovers in the live broadcasts we will hold with BlackRose on the 29th of January at 08:00 PM Pacific Time and Rosealyn on the 3rd of February at 4:00 PM Pacific Time.

We welcome everyone who loves story-based games to The Storyteller's Festival to enter Leila's mind and experience a part of her life story.

We released a demo created just for the Next Fest. It's not a full episode from the game, but instead little snippets from different episodes. We've gone this way to avoid spoilers and ruining your gaming experience, so we hope you enjoy it! 

If you would like to give us feedback, please feel free to post it on our discord server or steam community group!

The demo will be de-activated one week after the Next Fest.

notes.title: Gaming Istanbul 2023 Indie Contest 3rd Place
notes.content: At the GIST (Gaming Istanbul) fair held between September 22-25, we had our demo played by gamers and game industry professionals for 3 days, and on the last day of the fair, after presenting our game to a jury of academics, game publishers and game industry professionals, we received our 3rd place award on the main stage! Thanks to everyone who tried our game and gave us their valuable feedback!
